transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Nice to meet you too. Um, well, I came in because... I keep hearing Garrett’s voice. It's as clear as if he’s standing right behind me when I'm out on the trail or in my painting room. And, I mean, even though part of me knows he’s dead, in the moment... it just feels completely real.
Is the voice you hear always Garrett’s voice?
Yeah, it's... it's just him. Like I mentioned, it's always Garrett. I haven't heard anyone else. It's just his voice, right there behind me, exactly like I was saying.
Did Garrett die recently?
Yeah, it was... about a month ago. This whole crisis has basically been unfolding since then, for the last month or so since he passed.
Since Garrett died, have you been feeling depressed most of the day nearly every day?

No, not really. I mean, I was sad when it happened, obviously, but I haven't been sitting around feeling depressed or crying all day. If anything, I've just been really focused on my painting and hiking.
Do you believe Garrett is actually still alive?
No, I know he's dead. I... I don't think he's secretly alive or anything like that. I know he passed away. It's just that I still hear his voice, exactly like I told you.
Besides hearing Garrett’s voice, have you had any other experiences that felt unreal or strange, like seeing things others couldn’t see or feeling that someone was sending you messages?

No, nothing like that. I haven't seen anything unusual, and... no, I don't think anyone is sending me secret messages or anything. It's really just hearing his voice. That's the only thing like that that's been happening.
When you hear Garrett’s voice, does it usually happen when you’re thinking about him?

Not always, no. That's actually why I came in, to be honest. I just keep hearing his voice as clearly as if he’s standing right behind me. It happens when I'm out on the trail, or in my painting room... and it doesn't really matter what I was just thinking about. It's just so clear. Even though part of me knows he’s dead, in the exact moment I hear him, it feels completely real.
Have you been having trouble staying focused or feeling confused at times?

Yes, definitely having trouble staying focused. I can't seem to hold my attention on my patient documentation at work, or... or even just a normal conversation. It's like every little thing pulls me completely off track. A noise out in the hallway, the light on a phone, or just a specific phrase someone uses—my mind just latches onto it and I completely lose whatever I was supposed to be doing.
Since Garrett died, have other people told you that you've been acting very differently from usual?

Yes, my wife has definitely noticed. She says I've been all over the place. Sometimes I'm just constantly pacing around the house, rearranging papers and things, like I'm driven by a motor and just can't stop moving. But then other times, I'll just sit at the kitchen table, completely slowed down. She says it takes me forever just to answer a simple question when I get like that.
Before all this started, had you been ill, injured your head, or had a seizure?
No, nothing like that. I haven't been sick, and I definitely haven't hit my head or had any seizures. Physically, I've been fine before all this started.
Since this started, have there been times when you felt unusually high, euphoric, or extremely irritable?

Yes. At first, I felt almost... lit up. It was like I had some kind of urgent purpose that no one else could see or understand. But if anyone questioned me about it, or tried to slow me down, I would just snap into a rage. So, yes, I was definitely extremely irritable.
Since this started, have you been needing much less sleep than usual?

Yes, definitely. Um, for weeks I was sleeping maybe two or three hours a night, tops, but I felt completely wired. Like I didn't even need the rest. But then... I started crashing. It turned into this broken, really heavy sleep, but it doesn't help. I still end up waking up way before dawn, just completely exhausted and feeling panicky.
When you hear Garrett’s voice, is it only during the times when your mood feels unusually energized or irritable?

Yeah, it was. I only started hearing Garrett’s voice during that really wired stretch, when I was barely sleeping and taking on all those impossible projects. I just felt completely driven to keep going. I had never heard him like that before the mood shifted. It wasn’t... I mean, it wasn't something that happened during ordinary grief. It really only started when I got like that.
